pairs: I have lifted up my eyes to you,
Ecce sicut oculi servorum in manibus dominorum suorum;
Behold, as the eyes of the servants are on the hands of their masters,
sicut oculi ancillæ in manibus dominæ suæ: ita oculi nostri ad Dominum Deum nostrum,
as the eyes of the handmaid are on the hands of her mistress, so our eyes are upon the Lord our God,
until he may be merciful to us.
For we have been filled with utter disdain.
quia multum repleta est anima nostra opprobrium abundantibus,
For our soul has been greatly filled.
We are the disgrace of those who have abundance and the disdain of the arrogant.
